judge_notes.opus5: The line this name trades on is the profit guide, and holding ~$1.6B FY EBITDA needs ~36% H2 margins against ~30% in H1 while consensus has not moved for 60 days (i2); a +68bp two-year move and HY spreads widening 37bp against $46B of fair-value loans is a new, documented hit to that path (i0). Three straight 'revenue up, profit held' prints fell 6-15%. Shrunk hard for 17% of float short and rising at the low (i3).
judge_notes.opus55: The Q3 rate and credit-spread shock to the fair-value book, and a steep H2 EBITDA margin needed to hold a profit guide whose holding was sold three times, against a crowded 17% short at the lows.
judge_notes.sonnet55: Rate and spread shock on a fair-value loan book and a steep H2 EBITDA bar after three sell-offs on a held profit guide; 17% rising short and +10.5 skew keep it modest.
judge_notes.fable51: A 68bp 2-year move and wider HY spreads against a $47B fair-value book, and a held profit guide that now needs 36% H2 EBITDA margins, on a name that fell on three straight prints of the same shape with a +10.5 skew; the 17% rising short is the squeeze offset.
